# Ezekiel 47 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** The man brought me back to the entrance of the Temple. I saw water flowing from beneath the front of the Temple toward the east, since the Temple faced east. The water came from under the south side of the Temple, past the south side of the altar.

**2** He led me out through the north gateway and took me around to the outer eastern gateway. The water was flowing out from the south side of the gate.

**3** As the man walked eastward with a measuring line in his hand, he measured off 1,750 feet and led me through the water. It was ankle-deep.

**4** He measured off another 1,750 feet and led me through the water. This time it was up to my knees. He measured another 1,750 feet and the water was up to my waist.

**5** He measured off another 1,750 feet, and it was a river so deep I couldn't cross it on foot. It was deep enough to swim in — a river nobody could wade across.

**6** He asked me, "Son of man, do you see all this?" Then he led me back along the riverbank.

**7** When I got back, I was surprised to see many trees growing on both sides of the river.

**8** He explained, "This river flows east through the desert into the Dead Sea. When it reaches the Dead Sea, the salty water there becomes fresh!

**9** Wherever this river flows, everything will live. There will be swarms of living things and huge amounts of fish. Because this river flows there, the Dead Sea will be teeming with life! Everything it touches will live.

**10** Fishermen will line its shores. From En-gedi to En-eglaim the banks will be covered with nets drying in the sun. The fish will be as abundant and as varied as the fish of the Mediterranean Sea.

**11** But the swamps and marshes will not be made fresh. They will be left as a source of salt.

**12** All kinds of fruit trees will grow along both banks of the river. Their leaves will never turn brown and fall. There will always be fruit on their branches. Every month they will produce a fresh crop, because they are watered by the river flowing from the Temple. The fruit will be for eating and the leaves for healing.

**13** This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Here are the boundaries for dividing the land among the twelve tribes of Israel. Joseph gets a double portion.

**14** Divide the land equally. I swore to give this land to your ancestors, and it will now be your inheritance.

**15** These are the boundaries of the land: The northern border runs from the Mediterranean Sea along the road to Hethlon, then through Lebo-hamath to Zedad,

**16** continuing to Berothah and Sibraim, on the border between Damascus and Hamath, and on to Hazer-hatticon on the border of Hauran.

**17** So the northern border runs from the Mediterranean to Hazar-enan on the border of Damascus, with the boundary of Hamath to the north.

**18** The eastern border runs south from a point between Hauran and Damascus, along the Jordan River between Gilead and Israel, down to the Dead Sea as far as Tamar.

**19** The southern border runs from Tamar to the waters of Meribah-kadesh, then along the Brook of Egypt to the Mediterranean.

**20** On the west, the Mediterranean Sea is the boundary up to a point opposite Lebo-hamath.

**21** Divide this land among the tribes of Israel.

**22** Distribute it as an inheritance for yourselves and for the foreigners who have joined you and are raising families among you. They are to be treated like native-born Israelites and will receive an inheritance among the tribes.

**23** Wherever a foreigner lives, that tribe must give them an inheritance, says the Sovereign LORD.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **47:1-5**: Watch the river grow: ankle-deep, knee-deep, waist-deep, then over your head. What starts as a trickle from God's house becomes an unstoppable flood of life. God's blessings don't stay small — they keep growing and deepening and spreading.

- **47:8-9**: The Dead Sea is the deadest place on earth — nothing lives in it, nothing can. And God says, 'I'm going to make even the Dead Sea come alive.' There is no situation too dead, too far gone, too hopeless for God to bring life into it.

- **47:22-23**: This is a stunning statement: foreigners get a full inheritance alongside native-born Israelites. In God's restored community, there are no second-class citizens. Everyone belongs. Everyone receives.

— PNEUMA
